nodes.name: CLI
nodes.summary: pm2go command line: start, stop, restart, reload, scale, logs, save, resurrect, link, startup, hub. Talks to the daemon over a unix socket and spawns it on demand.

nodes.name: Daemon
nodes.summary: Long-lived process (pm2go daemon). Owns the process table, serves JSON-RPC on ~/.pm2go/rpc.sock, hosts the agent and the monitor loop.

nodes.name: Supervisor (Proc, Manager)
nodes.summary: Proc.supervise runs one child: restart policy, soft restarts (watch, cron, memory), graceful stop, readiness wait. Manager keeps instances, scale, rolling reload, save/resurrect and shared listeners.

nodes.name: Rotating log writer
nodes.summary: Children write through RotatingFile: size rotation, gzip, per-line callback that feeds the agent. Source of the 'children die with the daemon' limitation (#99).

nodes.name: Sampler
nodes.summary: CPU and RSS per process group and host metrics read from /proc (Linux). A ps based fallback exists only for macOS development.

nodes.name: CLI to daemon RPC
nodes.summary: Newline-delimited JSON over a unix socket. Method names and params in common/rpc.go.

nodes.name: Ecosystem and AppConfig
nodes.summary: AppConfig is the per-app configuration, also the dump file format. LoadEcosystem reads JSON ecosystem files with env_<profile> blocks.

nodes.name: Agent
nodes.summary: Runs inside the daemon. Dials the hub outbound over WebSocket and sends snapshots (2 s), events and log batches; executes hub commands.

nodes.name: Agent to hub protocol
nodes.summary: Envelope messages: hello, snapshot, event, logs, command, result. Defined in common/proto.go. Hot file.

nodes.name: Hub
nodes.summary: Web dashboard server (pm2go hub): accepts agents, stores data, evaluates alerts, notifies Telegram, serves the UI. Single static binary, SQLite storage.

nodes.name: Registry
nodes.summary: Connected agents, latest snapshot per server, per-process log rings (5000 lines), crash tracking, live log subscribers, command dispatch.

nodes.name: Alert engine
nodes.summary: Rules per (type, level). State machine pending, firing, resolved. Sustained thresholds, reminders, escalation (higher level covers lower).

nodes.name: Telegram notifier
nodes.summary: Sends alert messages through the Telegram Bot API with per-chat minimum level, rate limit and retry. Token is write-only in the API.

nodes.name: Issues grouping
nodes.summary: Error log lines are fingerprinted (numbers, ids, timestamps removed) and grouped with counts and a status.

nodes.name: Store (SQLite)
nodes.summary: Pure Go SQLite (modernc). Tables: servers, sys_metrics, proc_metrics, events, issues, alert_rules, alert_history, settings.

nodes.name: Schema migrations
nodes.summary: Versioned, append-only migration list applied in transactions (#89). Add a migration instead of editing old ones.

nodes.name: HTTP API and auth
nodes.summary: net/http mux with session cookie or bearer auth for the dashboard, agent key for /agent/ws, trust-proxy support, optional TLS (#95).

nodes.name: Dashboard UI
nodes.summary: Vanilla JS, no build, strict CSP, DOM built with h(). Pages register themselves (registerPage, registerNav). Servers, server, process with live logs, issues, alerts, settings.

nodes.name: sdk/runtime helper
nodes.summary: Stdlib-only helper for apps managed by pm2go: inherited shared listener (fd 3, LISTEN_FDS) and Ready() signal.

nodes.name: Docker and Caddy files
nodes.summary: Dockerfile, compose (host Caddy or bundled Caddy profile), Caddyfile examples, .env.example in servers/pm2go/deploy.

nodes.name: CI and release workflow
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions pm2go.yml: gofmt, vet, race tests, Linux build, image build with /healthz smoke test, Linux binaries and image on tags.

nodes.name: Telegram Bot API
nodes.summary: Alert delivery channel. Only tested against a fake server so far (#106).

nodes.name: Caddy
nodes.summary: Reverse proxy and TLS terminator in front of the hub; already installed on the platform.

nodes.name: Docker
nodes.summary: Runs the hub image; not installed on the dev machine, image never run by hand yet.

nodes.name: systemd
nodes.summary: Starts the daemon and the hub on boot via generated units (pm2go startup).

nodes.name: SQLite
nodes.summary: Embedded storage engine for the hub (modernc.org/sqlite, no cgo).

nodes.name: Linux /proc
nodes.summary: Source of CPU, memory, load and network numbers. Verified on macOS only through the ps fallback (#106).

nodes.name: Browser
nodes.summary: Operator view: dashboard, live logs over WebSocket, rule editor, settings.

nodes.name: GitHub
nodes.summary: Issues #89 to #106, PR #88 (integration branch to main), Actions.

nodes.name: Restart policy
nodes.summary: A run shorter than min_uptime is unstable. max_restarts counts consecutive unstable runs, then status errored. Backoff doubles up to 15 s. stop_exit_codes end supervision.

nodes.name: Soft restart
nodes.summary: watch, cron_restart and max_memory_restart restart at once, count in restarts, never count as unstable, report their own reason.

nodes.name: Instances
nodes.summary: instances: N runs N processes under one name with PMGO_INSTANCE_ID. scale changes the count live; reload restarts one at a time.

nodes.name: Shared listening socket
nodes.summary: Daemon opens the listener once per app and passes it as fd 3 (LISTEN_FDS=1) to every instance. Gives cluster-style port sharing and zero-downtime reload (#98).

nodes.name: wait_ready
nodes.summary: App signals readiness through a pipe; reload waits for it before stopping the old instance (#98).

nodes.name: Agent connects outbound
nodes.summary: Hosts dial the hub; the hub never connects to hosts, so monitored hosts need no inbound port.

nodes.name: Sustained threshold
nodes.summary: A metric rule fires only after the condition holds for duration_s. repeat_s sends reminders while firing; resolve needs 10 s of false.

nodes.name: Escalation
nodes.summary: Several rules of one type with rising thresholds and levels. While the higher level fires for the same target, the lower level stays quiet.

nodes.name: Issue fingerprint
nodes.summary: Error lines reduced to a stable shape (timestamps, numbers, hex ids, quoted values removed) so repeats group together.

nodes.name: Trusted proxy
nodes.summary: PMGO_TRUST_PROXY=1 makes the hub believe X-Forwarded-For and X-Forwarded-Proto. Only safe behind Caddy on a private port.

nodes.name: Schema migrations
nodes.summary: Append-only versioned migrations; downgrade is refused.

nodes.name: Per-issue work files
nodes.summary: Each session writes status, decisions and notes only to its own pm2go-work/<NNN>-*.md file so parallel PRs never conflict on shared docs.

nodes.name: Integration branch
nodes.summary: feat/pm2go-process-manager collects every feature PR; PR #88 merges it to main once, because main runs release workflows on every push.

nodes.name: Children tied to the daemon
nodes.summary: Child output goes through daemon pipes, so children die with the daemon. KillMode=control-group in the unit. Fix tracked in #99.

nodes.name: Start an app
nodes.summary: CLI builds AppConfig (flags or ecosystem) -> RPC start -> Manager.Start creates or updates Procs by name -> Proc.Start spawns the supervise loop.

nodes.name: Telemetry
nodes.summary: Monitor samples /proc every 2 s -> Proc caches usage -> Agent builds Snapshot every 2 s -> Hub Registry.OnSnapshot -> SQLite every 10 s -> dashboard charts.

nodes.name: Log stream
nodes.summary: Child output -> RotatingFile (file + line hook) -> Agent batch (500 ms) -> Registry ring + issue grouping + live subscribers -> dashboard WebSocket.

nodes.name: Alerting
nodes.summary: Engine.Evaluate every 2 s over Registry states -> per rule state machine -> level suppression -> Notifier -> Telegram; history stored in SQLite.

nodes.name: Remote command
nodes.summary: Browser POST /api/servers/{name}/command -> Registry.Command -> agent exec -> Manager method -> CommandResult back to the browser.
